hypotheses.name: Seismicity-to-conductance down-dip phase offset
hypotheses.physical_signature: Directed 200-800 m cross-strike offset, along +grad(depth_to_base), between the seismicity ridge and the shallow conductance (smectite-cap) ridge — the geometric signature of a 50-65 deg dipping permeable fault.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Blind intrabasin geothermal faults under zero-relief playas have no scarp; the dipping-plane offset between deep seismicity and shallow alteration cap is their predicted fingerprint.
hypotheses.novelty: Preregistered-deferred as H86I-2_MTCS in research/H86I_RKSC_PREREGISTRATION.md; never executed. H86M-CNT used conductance neck topology without directed seismic phase offset.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lateral facies-controlled conductance fronts offset from unrelated seismicity by chance alignment.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-moderate; physically specific but the catalogue-hide instrument may under-reward blind-basin geometry (withheld catalogue faults are mapped, hence surface-expressed).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (directed cross-correlation along local basement-dip azimuth).
hypotheses.falsifier: Offset score fails vs zero-offset co-location control in paired CI.

hypotheses.name: Spin-2 seismic tensor x conductance-gradient alignment under transtension
hypotheses.physical_signature: Angular concordance between the seismicity structure-tensor orientation and conductance-gradient orientation, weighted by transtensional strain (shear x dilatation).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Nascent transtensional accommodation zones (Walker Lane) have minimal throw but aligned seismicity and fluid-conductivity boundaries.
hypotheses.novelty: Deferred as H86I-3_SPBT; H86I-SACD used spin-2 Coulomb concordance on potential fields, not seismic-conductance tensor alignment. Overlaps EQL's tensor machinery, hence ranked below it.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Regional strain-aligned joint sets and survey-grid anisotropies shared by both fields.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-moderate; two weak fields multiplied can vanish, but a win would be highly specific.
hypotheses.falsifier: Alignment product fails vs either single-field control in paired CI.

hypotheses.name: Transtensional regime-angle gated horsetail splays
hypotheses.physical_signature: Principal strain-rate eigendecomposition (e1,e2)=B8/2 +/- B7 and regime angle atan2(B8,2B7) gating magnetic lineaments into wrench vs extensional horsetail families.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Transfer zones partition slip onto buried basin-floor strands without range-front scarps.
hypotheses.novelty: Preregistered-not-run as H86I-CHTD (research/SESSION_H86I_RLMS_REVIEW_20261025.md); GDSC/WVB used scalar strain only, no regime angle. Ranked last: geodetic bands are very smooth at 100 m grid, limiting dot-level information.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Smooth interpolation artifacts of the GPS strain grid masquerading as corridors.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low at pixel scale; mostly a regional gate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Regime-gated surface fails vs ungated magnetic-edge control in paired CI.

required_before_any_experiment: An explicit single assigned method paragraph; current request has none.
The actual shared cached feature stack with generating-code, input-hash, preprocessing and visible-mask identity; native bands or historical hashes are not substitutes.
A shared/upstream resolution of the unchanged literal full-support witness stop; do not change support thresholds privately.
A complete current registry with an auditable policy for incompatible entries.
Freeze buffered whole-segment hide-and-recover folds; derive all catalogue features from visible faults only; mask visible fault pixels exactly.
Run isolated-feature leakage canaries before trusting a feature; AUC above 0.90 is a stop pending proof.
Use the shared evaluator, pooled DTI with alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, and 300 m triangular kernel; report evaluator, withheld-positive count, and 95% CI.
Check rank correlation on the surface before placement and 3-px overlap on final dots against the complete registry; stop above 0.90 correlation or 0.70 overlap.
Use no more than three experiments or two hours, and no weekly slot until a separate selector.
